# Points triggers

## Points threshold reached

Runs when a viewer's points reach a goal number, like 1000. You set the goal numbers on the Points page. Good for a "you reached 1000!" cheer.

| Setting | What to put in |
| --- | --- |
| **Threshold** | Only react to this goal number, like 1000. Empty means any goal set on the Points page. |
| **Currency** | Only react to this kind of points, like "Coins". Empty means any. |

**Variables you get**

| Variable | What it holds |
| --- | --- |
| `%user%` | The viewer who reached the goal |
| `%threshold%` | The goal number that was reached |
| `%points%` | How many points they have now |
| `%previousPoints%` | How many they had before |
| `%currency%` | The name of the points |
| `%platform%` | The site the viewer is on, like twitch |

<small>Type id: `points.thresholdCrossed`</small>
